Grammatical focus is used to draw attention of the listener and is always in the main level verb phrase ([[bridi]]).

The most usual method of shifting focus is by using {{jvs|fi'o}}.

{{mu|mi djuno lo du'u do stati|I know that you are smart.}}
is turned into
{{mu|fi'o djuno mi do stati|As I know, you are smart.}}
